name: jinshi-territory
description: A multiplayer territory-capture arena built for local play and Discord Activities.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @jinshi-territory/shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jinshi-territory/shared && npm run build -w @jinshi-territory/server && npm run build -w @jinshi-territory/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @jinshi-territory/shared && npm run test -w @jinshi-territory/server && npm run test -w @jinshi-territory/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @jinshi-territory/shared && npm run typecheck -w @jinshi-territory/server && npm run typecheck -w @jinshi-territory/client
